# Harbour Supply

Harbour Supply sells canvas bags. This file is part of a benchmark fixture, not a
real shop, so every address below resolves inside the fixture's own capture.

## Catalogue

- [Bags collection](https://example.com/collections/bags): the full listing, with the
  sort and filter controls that generate the faceted URLs.
- [Harbour Tote in navy](https://example.com/products/harbour-tote-navy): the page
  carrying the deliberate review-markup defect.
- [Harbour Tote in slate](https://example.com/products/harbour-tote-slate): the second
  colour variant, which shares its title with the navy page on purpose.
- [Field Satchel](https://example.com/products/field-satchel): the page carrying the
  offer and image defects.

## Notes

Every link here is absolute and https, which is what the two llms.txt checks read.
The cart and the checkout are deliberately not listed: both serve noindex, and a
discovery file should not point at pages the site excludes.
